text: Can you make a meme using this attached cat pic? I've had one of those weeks where I keep getting the day wrong, so this feels very relatable. I want it to be square, with the top text saying exactly "WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY" and the bottom text saying exactly "BUT IT'S ONLY TUESDAY". The cat's expression is what made me want to do this in the first place. Please use big white letters with black outlines, and keep the cat's eyes clear.
